name: Diveen Henry
bio: Diveen Henry is a British actress of stage and screen. She was born in South London and studied at Webber Douglas Academy. She is best known for for roles in All Or Nothing (2002) The Thick of It election special (2007) and Prosperity (2007) directed by Lenny Abrahamson. In addition to her numerous television roles, she has performed onstage with the RSC and the Globe.
